youtube.posts: business, money, careers, founders, investing, self-help with stakes: podcast and interview moments where someone with a track record says something a stranger can use
youtube.never: product demos, app promos, brand ads, gaming, music, drama

instagram.posts: celebrity, pop culture, drama, gossip, relationships, dating, reality TV, fashion and beauty talk: moments people screenshot and send to a friend
instagram.never: finance talk, gaming, software, brand ads

tiktok.posts: entertainment: streamers, gaming WITH a personality on screen, comedy, music and live performance, movie and show scenes with actors, sports moments
tiktok.never: silent game footage, trailers of products, app promos, brand ads, anything with an AI voice-over

rule: A campaign must fit exactly one account's identity or it is rejected at the scan. A promo of any kind (app, brand, product, game launch, token) never fits.
